value.rationale: At the first order of genuine inverse ambiguity for unit-edge metric-tree two-point geometry, two collision classes survive a complete preexisting Hosoya census. One natural three-sample shared-anchor moment, measuring spatial heterogeneity of mean distance, removes both failures with exact nonzero gaps and a full finite cutoff. The new fact needs third-order dependence absent from the prior polynomial tables and is a motivated exact inverse-geometric discriminator, not a routine change in parameter or re-tabulation.
